inventory.intro: Kumpi nopeampi? compare trips using both quantities.
inventory.hints: Read both distance and time; numeric decimal display incidental, comparison is target.
inventory.transfer: ratio comparison remains base content when SIM_SHARE.transfer=0.
inventory.animations: raceScene/perSecondScene and shared motion player; simulation version adds40m speed-target rally.
inventory.audit: Per-lesson audit reports revisions/corrected demos; not independently accepted or learner tested.

alignment.inherited: Distance/time comparison, m/s language, sameS/sameT/equal families.
alignment.extended: Explicit whole-trip stopped-time example distinguishes average from moving-only speed.
alignment.corrected: Avoid race winner as universal speed proxy for unequal distances; make complete-trips comparison explicit.

planning.teacherObjective: Keskinopeuden ymmärtäminen matkan ja ajan suhteena
planning.scope: Keskinopeuden merkitys; ei kaavamuunnosten sujuvuusarviointia eikä vektorinopeutta.
planning.assumed: Metri, sekunti, matka ja aika (PHY79-DIST-TIME). Jakaminen havainnollistetaan yhtä aikayksikköä kohti; ei piilossa desimaalilaskentavaatimusta.
planning.evidenceLimits: Practice is feedback for interpretation only; no mastery, retained recall or physical measurement claim.
planning.simulation: Deterministic straight tracks, x=distance*min(t/movingDuration,1); mean includes full own-trip duration including stop. One common playback clock starts both trips; each trip timer caps at own completion. Stopping early after a completed trip is distinct from the authored in-trip pause. Playback seconds equal simulation seconds; no decorative animation clock.
planning.assetProvenance: Supplied v2 generated raster reinterpretations from user package, unchanged pixels; original SVG diagram created here. No automatic licence assignment.

comparisonCorrection.finding: Current case selector input-only/readback mismatch independently reproduced; both semantic events and visible readback now govern checking and controls.
comparisonCorrection.scope: Case synchronization only; authored trips, units, comparisons, static representations and teaching boundaries unchanged.
